verdict.rationale: The evidence documents per-message Graph API operations, query filtering, and Inbox rules for incoming mail. Nothing documents a bulk or batch operation that acts on many existing items in one action. Per-item CRUD and filtering are developer building blocks, and Inbox rules are an adjacent automation that applies only to incoming messages, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
